title: Universal scalar extension counit on K-flat module complexes
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, f:R\to B a ring homomorphism, and P an unbounded cochain complex of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose P is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]: its total tensor with any acyclic R-complex is acyclic. Let LF:D(R)\to D(B) be any universal total left derived functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of termwise extension of scalars along f [def-weil-module-base-change], with counit ε on K(R). Then ε at the homotopy image of P is an isomorphism. No flatness of f or boundedness of P is assumed.

proof.text: Use CochainComplex.kFlat_of_acyclic_tensor from KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso, imported with import all, to convert the acyclic-tensor hypothesis to the source-library kFlat predicate. This reuses the existing proved conversion rather than copying its proof.

Apply the existing CochainComplex.scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat from KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso, imported with import all. It states exactly that scalar extension preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Its mixed-tensor and degree-zero identification proof is reused, not duplicated.

Use the source-library Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_app_of_kFlat for extendScalars f. Its only functor-specific instance, PreservesKFlatQuasiIso, is supplied by the preceding existing scalar-extension lemma. ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution and exact countable colimits supply its ambient hypotheses. Apply the forward implication to the given hLF and the K-flat conversion of hP. This directly proves the given counit component invertible without constructing another universal pair.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtensionCounit_isIso_of_kFlat
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] (f : R →+* B)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor L P (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (LF : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶
      (extendScalars f).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hLF : LF.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ))) :
    IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj P))
